Car Total Cost of Ownership

True car cost: purchase plus fuel, insurance and maintenance minus resale over N years.

For information only — not financial advice. Excludes financing interest, taxes, and registration.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the purchase price and how many years you will keep the car.
  2. Enter annual miles, fuel economy, and fuel price.
  3. Enter yearly insurance and maintenance, plus expected resale value.
  4. Read the total ownership cost, cost per year, and cost per mile.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is included in total cost of ownership?

Purchase price plus fuel, insurance, and maintenance over the ownership period, minus what you expect to sell it for.

What is not included?

Financing interest, taxes and registration, depreciation beyond resale, parking, and tolls. Add them to maintenance if you want them counted.

Why subtract resale value?

Because money you recover at sale is not really spent. A car that holds value costs less to own.
